// ============================================================
// Purchasing: the application's navigation and logo
//
// The buyer's desk: purchase orders, suppliers, replenishment and demand.
// The logo is the SVG in assets/logos/purchasing.svg, inlined as a data URI (tools/embed-logos.py regenerates the line): Studio and Stage take
// a Screenplay document only, never a file beside it, and a data URI cannot 404.
// ============================================================

layout PurchasingNavigation
  category Shell
  content

  navigation topbar
    logo image "data:image/svg+xml;base64," title "Acme Purchasing"

  navigation sidebar
    item purchasing title "Purchasing" icon truck target Buying
      item purchaseorders title "Purchase orders" target Buying.PurchaseOrders
      item suppliers title "Suppliers" target Buying.Suppliers
      item replenishment title "Replenishment" target Buying.Replenishment
      item preferred title "Preferred suppliers" target Buying.Sourcing
      item demand title "Demand" target Buying.Demand
      item overview title "Dashboard" target Buying.Overview
